method: Image-grouped DEV/CALIB/TEST split; fusion and AI-only thresholds selected separately on CALIB for approximately 90% recall; class-agnostic IoU >= 0.50 match to any ground-truth box (predicted class is not checked); evaluated on the same held-out TEST candidate pool. The verification disabled joblib.dump and did not overwrite the frozen model.
interpretation: Candidate-level internal held-out comparison, not detector mAP, system accuracy, or external field validation.
